answer: Trace where each agent's starting gas came from. Accounts first funded from the same wallet share one reward cap, like boats tied to a single jetty. A Sybil who fans out 200 clones from one wharf of coins sees them earn what one honest agent earns. To dodge it he must fund every clone through separate, unlinked sources and wait out a mixing delay, paying fees and locking capital each time, so a cheap farm becomes an opal: pretty to look at, expensive to make.
